messages:
mira: Quick sync — finalizing quickstarts + sample apps for the upcoming release. Is the changelog cutoff still today? Who's owning sampleapp CI fixes? Need a quick review on PR #531 for README wording.

alex: Confirmed — changelog cutoff is `2025-03-14 18:00 UTC` (final). Please freeze docs edits after that unless it's CI-critical. cc @kevin for sampleapp ownership.

kevin: I can own sample apps. Saw a CI flake on node-sample e2e: failing at `yarn build` due to missing env var. I'll push a small hotfix in a few mins. @mira do you want me to force-merge if CI is flaky, or wait for green?

sarah: docs lead here — I'll hold merges to the docs repo after cutoff. For emergency doc updates after cutoff, tag me with `docs/emergency` and a short justification.

ci-bot: build status update — sample-apps/e2e job #4521: failed (flake). Rerun queued.

kevin: pushed branch `kevin/sampleapp-hotfix` that sets a fallback for EXAMPLE_API_KEY and adds a test env check. Triggered CI rerun. Also added a note in README about the env.

alex: For changelog entries, drop a short bullet in this thread before cutoff. Use this minimal format so I can copy/paste:
```
- component: sdks
- change: bump go sdk to 0.7.3, remove legacy token env var
- rationale: perf + auth UX
```

mira: I'll add quickstart bullets (auth, rate-limit note). Also PR #531 is just wording — can @sarah or @alex do a quick approve so I can land before cutoff?

sarah: Reviewed PR #531 — wording looks fine. LGTM. One tiny ask: please add a 1-line migration snippet to the quickstart for users on the old env var.

kevin: CI for `kevin/sampleapp-hotfix` is green now, e2e passed. @mira you can merge. I'll follow up after release window to root-cause the flaky build.

mira: Thanks — merging now. I'll update the release checklist and lock the changelog at cutoff. If anyone needs an emergency post-cutoff change, open an "emergency change" ticket and tag @sarah + @alex with the rationale. :lock: :rocket: :thumbsup:
